novel_features.name: Market-implied PKR short rate
novel_features.description: Derive a daily short-term interest rate series from the cross-section of money-market fund yields.
novel_features.rationale: Requires holding every money-market fund's annualized return for every date in one local table and taking a cross-sectional median; no MUFAP page shows this and the SBP policy-rate source is Cloudflare-blocked.
novel_features.why_it_matters: This is the only daily, backfillable PKR short-rate proxy obtainable without a blocked government source.
novel_features.group: Series only a local panel can produce

novel_features.name: Mutual fund equity exposure
novel_features.description: Total PKR the mutual fund industry holds in listed equities, by month, from per-fund asset allocation.
novel_features.rationale: Requires fanning out per-fund allocation calls across every AMC and summing the PKR amount column, because the percentage column is zero for everything before 2024.
novel_features.why_it_matters: It is the asset-side counterpart to a mutual-fund net-flow series, enabling a cross-source join no single publisher offers.
novel_features.group: Series only a local panel can produce

novel_features.name: Dated panel backfill
novel_features.description: Fetch the daily fund panel or monthly allocation across a date range into the local store.
novel_features.rationale: Every MUFAP data path is date-driven, so the generator emits no resource mirror; the panel has to be walked date by date and stored with an observed_at stamp.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Publication timing is what makes a variable admissible as ex-ante, so every row records when it was actually observed.

novel_features.name: Panel query
novel_features.description: Query the stored daily NAV and return panel by date, fund, category or sector.
novel_features.rationale: Requires the local SQLite mirror; the upstream site can only render one date at a time.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Turns 21 years of single-date HTML pages into one queryable table.

novel_features.name: Coverage ledger
novel_features.description: Show which dates were fetched, which returned zero rows, and which were never attempted.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a coverage table that records a date even when it legitimately holds no rows, which a date-set diff alone cannot see.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Distinguishes fetched-and-empty from never-fetched, so a gap is never mistaken for a zero.

novel_features.name: Arithmetic invariant check
novel_features.description: Check that fund asset-class percentages net to 100 and flag months whose percent columns are unpopulated.
novel_features.rationale: Requires comparing the amount columns against the percent columns across a whole month of funds; the site reports a hardcoded 100% label that does not reflect the actual sum.
novel_features.why_it_matters: A month that fails the invariant is corrupt input, not a weak signal, and must be excluded before modelling.

novel_features.name: Universe width
novel_features.description: Report how many funds reported on each date, by sector and category.
novel_features.rationale: Requires the coverage ledger plus the stored panel; universe width moves from 17 funds in 2005 to 526 in 2026 and is itself a regime marker.
novel_features.why_it_matters: A silently narrowing universe fakes verdicts, so width is printed alongside every cross-sectional result.

novel_features.name: Return dispersion
novel_features.description: Cross-sectional spread of fund returns within a category on each date.
novel_features.rationale: Requires every fund's return for a date in one table to compute a percentile spread.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Dispersion is a daily breadth measure that a single-fund page cannot express.
novel_features.group: Series only a local panel can produce

novel_features.name: Validity freshness audit
novel_features.description: Detect funds whose published NAV validity date lags the requested date.
novel_features.rationale: Requires comparing each row's own validity date against the fetch date; the live view mixes 14 different validity dates including stale and forward-priced rows.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Differencing the live view without this check manufactures returns that never happened.

novel_features.name: Bulk dump
novel_features.description: Dump the stored panel, allocation or coverage tables as JSONL for piping, a single JSON array for agents, or CSV.
novel_features.rationale: Requires the local store; lets an external research database load two decades of panel without re-fetching, and names the local mirror rather than implying an API round-trip the way a command sitting next to `import` would.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Lets an analysis pipeline consume the panel directly instead of scraping.

narrative.headline: Pakistan's mutual fund industry as a dated local panel: two decades of daily NAVs, monthly PKR asset allocation, and a market-implied short rate no other tool derives.
narrative.value_prop: MUFAP publishes one HTML page per date and nothing else. This CLI walks those dates into a local SQLite panel with an observed_at stamp on every row, then derives series the site never shows: a daily short-rate proxy from money-market fund yields, industry equity exposure in rupees, and cross-sectional return dispersion. It records which dates returned zero rows, so a gap is never mistaken for a zero.
narrative.auth_narrative: No credentials. MUFAP sits behind Cloudflare, so the CLI ships a Chrome-fingerprint HTTP transport that clears the challenge without a browser, a clearance cookie, or any login.

quickstart.comment: Confirm the Chrome-fingerprint transport reaches MUFAP before fetching anything
27 asset managers; their GUIDs key every fund lookup
Walk four dates into the local panel, one request per date
Confirm what was actually stored, including any zero-row dates
Derive the market-implied short rate from the stored panel

troubleshoots.symptom: Every command returns an empty result and doctor reports a challenge page
troubleshoots.fix: MUFAP requires the Chrome-fingerprint transport; confirm http_transport is browser-http and retry, as plain HTTP always returns HTTP 403.

troubleshoots.symptom: A historical month of allocation data shows every percentage as zero
troubleshoots.fix: Percent columns are unpopulated before roughly 2024; use the PKR amount columns and divide by Total, which is what `exposure` does.
Pass the integer fund code from `funds by-amc` to --fund-code, not the FundID GUID, and format --month as M-YYYY such as 7-2026.

troubleshoots.symptom: A fetched date holds fewer funds than expected
troubleshoots.fix: Run `universe` for that date; weekends and holidays legitimately return a small or empty panel, and `coverage` distinguishes that from a failed fetch.

troubleshoots.symptom: Today's panel mixes several different validity dates
troubleshoots.fix: The current-day view is a latest-available-per-fund fallback; run `freshness` to see the lag, and prefer an explicit historical date, which returns a clean single-date panel.

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for this CLI when you need Pakistani mutual fund data as a time series rather than a single lookup: building a dated panel of fund NAVs, deriving a short-rate proxy, measuring industry asset allocation in rupees, or checking how many funds actually reported on a given date. It is built for research pipelines that care about publication timing and about telling a real zero apart from a missing observation.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI for live PSX equity prices or index levels; it holds fund NAVs, not stock quotes.
Do not use it to buy, sell, or redeem fund units; MUFAP is an industry association site and exposes no transaction surface.
Do not use it for daily fund AUM; net assets and asset allocation are published monthly, and only NAV and returns are daily.
Do not use it as an official policy-rate source; the rates command is a market-implied proxy derived from fund yields, not a State Bank publication.

recipes.title: Build the short-rate series
recipes.explanation: Returns one row per date with the cross-sectional median money-market yield and the number of funds behind it, so a thin date is visible rather than silently averaged.

recipes.title: Industry equity exposure by month
recipes.explanation: Sums the PKR stocks-and-equities column across every fund, giving the asset-side series to pair against mutual-fund net flows.

recipes.title: Audit a month before trusting it
recipes.explanation: Flags funds whose asset-class percentages do not net to 100 after subtracting liabilities, which the site's own 100% label hides.

recipes.title: Check universe width before any cross-section
recipes.explanation: Prints how many funds reported per date so a narrowing universe cannot fake a result.

recipes.title: Export the panel for external analysis
recipes.explanation: Streams the stored panel as newline-delimited JSON for loading into a research database without re-fetching.
